name: 600 EX front brake caliper (CS-49)
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 150 g for the complete front BR-6210 CS-49 side-pull caliper with factory NBM brake pads and mounting bolt, from the April 1982 catalogue. The source does not identify which standard or optional sunken mounting-bolt variant was weighed.
